calls.statement:
SELECT channel_code, channel_id, count(*) n, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, min(etl_loaded_at) l0, max(etl_loaded_at) l1
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT status, fulfilment_type, login_state, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx, sum(order_total_gross) tot
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2024-07-27' AND order_ts_utc < '2024-10-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, o.status, o.order_total_gross, o.line_count FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27')
SELECT coalesce(status,'NO ORDER') status, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) orders, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl, sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(net_amount) net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_diff_utc
FROM w GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id,f.line_no)) drl
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc::TIMESTAMPTZ) AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism_local,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism_utc, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27'

WITH l AS (SELECT receipt_id, sum(gross_amount) g, count(*) c, min(sale_date) d FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines, sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND abs(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN l.c<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cnt_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND l.d <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc::TIMESTAMPTZ) AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_vs_order
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= '2024-07-27' AND o.order_ts_utc < '2024-10-30' GROUP BY 1

SELECT sale_date, sale_ts_utc, hour(sale_ts_utc) h, (sale_date - CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)) dd, month(sale_date) m, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27' AND CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY random() LIMIT 8

FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

UNION ALL SELECT 'wb_nonpositive_qty_or_amt', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27' AND (quantity<=0 OR gross_amount<=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'wb_max_gross_x100', max(gross_amount)*100 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27'

UNION ALL SELECT 'wb_distinct_stores', count(DISTINCT store_key) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27'
